subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: Should strict unclosed-reasoning recovery use a following `<final>` boundary to preserve only visible answer text, and should that land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90924 or a narrower channel-delivery patch?
rationale: The remaining behavior is a security-sensitive sanitizer fallback, and maintainer intent is needed to decide whether answer recovery after malformed `<think>` output should be preserved or fail closed to avoid hidden reasoning leakage.

options.title: Land shared final-boundary recovery
